lemmas.statement: On a halted state s, replaying the block of any ProposalRecord s yields the same state s (proposal_confers_no_execution).
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem proposal_confers_no_execution (s : State) (p : GraphGenesis.ProposalRecord s) (h : halted s) : replay s p.block = s := by sorry

near_misses.claim: The block in ProposalRecord is the canonical or unique member of upFamily s.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The record only asserts branch-local membership in upFamily s, with no canonicality or uniqueness claim and no minimality or initiality property.

near_misses.claim: ProposalRecord.cost is an exact rational cost accounting.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: cost is a declared Nat-valued resource demand, not a rational cost.
